author: D. Lakshmi
comment: Excellent service providing, recently booked a cook from this agency good and neat candidates and the agency responsed well compared to others. Thanks to staff Mrs.Kuzhali

author: Divya & Rajesh K.
comment: Post-delivery care was very challenging for us without family nearby. The newborn caretaker arranged by Colours Life Manpower Agency was patient, gentle with the baby's bath and sleep routine, and extremely helpful to the mother.

author: Ganga
comment: Most efficient, reliable and caring service. Owner Mr. Thomas is very prompt and approachable at all times. We availed their service to take care of my grandma, we are so happy with their staff caring and politeness. I would strongly recommend.

author: Suchitra
comment: I hired a maid from them. Good background verification done by them. They immediately referred a maid to my house. She was very good and comfortable for us. Good follow up also was done. Good customer care. I wil strongly recommend to all

author: Hari Priya
comment: Delivering top-tier vegetarian culinary talent with unparalleled expertise and a passion for flavor, the Colours life man power agency ensures that every kitchen experience is elevated to a masterpiece of taste and satisfaction.

author: Dr. Arun Kumar
comment: After my dad's hip surgery, we required an attendant for home bedside assistance. The helper assisted with wheelchair transfers, hygiene, and daily care with great diligence.
